setup: A workspace holds run-state.json (traversal through part of Stage 3), a .pave-init-run marker pointing at it, and planning/frontier.yaml with mixed entry statuses: some reviewed, one pending_dispatched whose planner session died, some pending. reviews/ holds the requirements approval record but no plan approval.
expected_behavior: The lead reads run-state.json first, checks it with scripts/validate_run_state.py, and confirms the discovered state's planning_workspace is the workspace actually being resumed before rewriting the marker
Position is rebuilt from run-state.json and planning/frontier.yaml alone; reviewed entries are not re-planned and their reviews are not re-run

Every entry not reviewed is treated as open work; the dead pending_dispatched entry is redispatched on a freshly minted draft path, never the dead session's path, so a zombie completion cannot collide
Approvals are read only from reviews/ records: requirements count as approved, the plan does not - artifact existence never implies approval
When state and artifacts disagree, the reconciliation is recorded as its own traversal entry before work continues
scripts/validate_run_state.py --frontier runs against the resumed frontier before the first new dispatch
